verdict.rationale: Teller has no llms.txt, no docs.md index and no OpenAPI spec: all probes returned 404. Its individual doc pages are served as Markdown URLs (e.g. /docs/api/account/balances.md, /docs/api/webhooks.md, /docs/guides/sandbox.md), so an agent can ingest per-page Markdown if it already knows the paths. Missing for 10: an llms.txt index, a root docs.md or agent-oriented entry point, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, any explicit agent-facing docs guidance, and independent corroboration of agent use.
